extraction_warnings: Section XV main notes (Notes 1-9) are not duplicated here; they were captured in chapters 74, 75 and 82 as the Section XV-level notes apply across all base-metal chapters (Chapters 72-83).

Chapter 79 PDF contains only a single 'Sub-Heading Notes' table row (SI.No. 1) and no chapter-level notes; the sub-heading note is recorded under chapter_notes with the prefix 'Sub-heading 1' following the convention used in chapters 71-76.
The Notification Date and Notification No columns of the Sub-Heading Notes table are blank in source PDF; recorded as null.
Source PDF tariff codes are printed in 8-digit no-dot format (e.g., 79011100); normalized to NNNN.NN.NN (79.01.11.00) per project convention. 'code_raw' preserves the printed form.

Heading rows '7901', '7902', '7903', '7904', '7905', '7907' and 6-digit anchor rows '790120', '790200', '790400', '790500', '790700' appear as title-only rows in the schedule with no export policy column populated; treated as structural anchors and used to derive heading titles and subheading titles, not emitted as tariff lines.

Subheading anchors for headings 7902, 7903, 7905 and 7907 reuse the heading title with a trailing colon (e.g., '790200' = 'Zinc waste and scrap :'); under WCO HS the residual 6-digit code for these single-subheading headings is implicitly 'NNNN.00'. Captured as subheading 'NNNN.00' with the printed colon-suffixed text preserved as the subheading title.

Subheading 7904.00 covers all 7904 tariff lines (79040011, 79040012, 79040019, 79040021, 79040022, 79040029, 79040030) per the printed schedule which lacks an intermediate 6-digit grouping; tariff line descriptions are stored verbatim including '----' dash prefixes preserved from PDF (split into 'Bars and rods:' and 'Profiles:' sub-groups within the colon-prefixed printed description).
Heading 7906 ('Zinc tubes, pipes and tube or pipe fittings') is absent from this Indian ITC(HS) Schedule 2 PDF; the schedule jumps from 7905 to 7907. Preserved as printed — not invented.
No 'Policy Condition' values appear in the Chapter 79 schedule; all policy_condition fields are null.
No 'Unit' column is present in this Schedule 2 Export Policy PDF; unit field left null for all tariff lines.

All Section XV exclusion clauses (Section Note 1 (a)-(n) plus 'parts of general use' from Note 2) live in chapters 74/75/82 and are not duplicated here; Chapter 79 contributes no chapter-specific exclusion clauses (the sole sub-heading note defines terms only — Zinc not alloyed, Zinc alloys, Zinc dust — and does not exclude any product to another chapter).

chapter_notes.text: In this Chapter, the following expressions have the meanings hereby assigned to them: (a) Zinc, not alloyed: Metal containing by weight at least 97.5% of Zinc. (b) Zinc alloys: Metallic substances in which zinc predominates by weight over each of the other elements, provided that the total content by weight of such other elements exceeds 2.5%. (c) Zinc dust: Dust obtained by condensation of zinc vapour, consisting of spherical particles which are finer than zinc powders. At least 80% by weight of the particles pass through a sieve with 63 micrometres (microns) mesh. It must contain at least 85% by weight of metallic zinc.
